standard-dialogue.player: Hello, what's a little boy like you doing down here?

standard-dialogue.npc: I ain't no little boy. Me dad, Steve, said I was big enough to take care of these 'ere wyverns, as the pal- palint-palintililiolog- those blokes from the museum are too scared of them.

options.text: Calm down, I was just worried.

steps.npc: Yeah, whatever. I know how to look after myself, my entire family are slayer guardians or something like that.
To guard the wyverns of course.
From people like you who just want to kill 'em.
They have lives too. They were created for a purpose. But whatever, you can only kill these ones if the Slayer Masters say you can.
Well, it's kinda a family tradition you might say. Plus I'm good at looking after wyverns and fast enough to weave between their legs and not get hurt.

when-attempting-to-kill-monsters-that-ar.npc: Hey! Leave them alone! My dad Steve will beat you up unless a Slayer Master has given you special permission.
